proposed_sentence: At the preview, the light caught the bottle beside my fabric. I noticed the shape, not what was inside it.
assessment: Recommended. The added location resolves my noted ambiguity by placing the observed physical bottle at the preview, rather than allowing the preceding private-room account to imply that the bottle itself reached the waiting glass. It aligns with the finale's extraction-at-preview, poisoning-later account.
qualification: It does remove an unintended inference I actually used at intermediate checkpoints: that Elle had observed bottle and target glass together. That inference raised my early suspicion, so I would not claim this is neutral to every reader's timing or confidence. The final available deduction remains: Elle had access to the physical poison source at the preview, admitted proximity to the unattended target glass later, and falsely reclassified the bottle as a projection despite the retained slides showing only weaving. The added phrase supplies scene location, not a new act of extraction, tampering, or poisoning.
